Home.title: Overlap
Home.tagline: Meet the people your campus life already overlaps with.
Home.whatBody: We introduce you to people based on campus life you actually overlap with — the same class, the same club, similar free time. Not just a photo to swipe past, but a reason you'd get along.
Home.whyBody: Instead of endless swiping, we introduce 6 carefully picked people every day at noon. Each one comes with the reasons you overlap, so you can find people who actually share your interests, faster.
Home.safetyBody: Only verified students can be matched with, and you can block or report anyone at any time. When it's time to meet, we suggest public spots on campus.
Home.statusNote: We're still building this. Join the waitlist and we'll email you the moment we open.

HowMatchingWorks.title: How matching works
HowMatchingWorks.intro: Your daily picks are chosen by a set of rules we run on our own servers — not by a person browsing profiles, and not by machine learning or generative AI. Every match is based on things you and the other person both entered: your courses, clubs, free time, interests and a short values quiz.
HowMatchingWorks.signalCourses: Shared courses — sharing a small class counts for more than sharing something everyone takes.
HowMatchingWorks.signalClubs: Shared clubs and organizations, weighted the same way.
HowMatchingWorks.signalTime: Overlapping free time, plus any hangout spots you've both opted into.
HowMatchingWorks.signalInterests: Shared interests from the tag list — rarer interests count for more.
HowMatchingWorks.signalValues: How close your answers are on the 8-item values quiz.
HowMatchingWorks.weightsTitle: It depends on what you're looking for
HowMatchingWorks.weightsBody: Which of these matters most changes with the mode you're browsing in: study buddy leans on shared courses and free time; friends leans on clubs and interests; dating weighs values and interests more heavily. A match only counts if it looks good from both sides — one person being a great fit for the other isn't enough on its own.
HowMatchingWorks.batchBody: Every day at noon we put together 6 people per mode you're active in: your 4 best matches, one person ranked a bit further down the list so you don't only ever see the same kind of profile, and one recent newcomer. No one profile can appear in more than 25 people's picks on the same day, so early or popular profiles don't crowd everyone else out.
HowMatchingWorks.explanationsBody: Each pick shows up to 3 concrete reasons — the specific course, club, interest, free-time overlap or values fit behind the score. We only ever show something you both actually have; nothing about anyone's private preferences is ever revealed this way.
HowMatchingWorks.rightsBody: This is an automated process, which you have the right to ask about. If you'd like an explanation for a specific match, or a human to review how your picks are put together, contact us and we'll follow up.
